bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for the safe routes to school program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SAFE ROUTES TO SCHOOL PROGRAM.

$20,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $20,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for the safe routes to school program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.40. $20,000,000 is added to the annual base for this activity.
